items.reason: D30-R7 settles exactly this case ("grade III or grade IV glioma", no IDH requirement); the DIPG allowance does not change it.

note: Imaging-only EARLY_PHASE1 study (FET and FMISO PET tracers, both diagnostic_agent); excluded at S6 regardless of S5, reason excluded_intervention_type under D31-C1 (tested intervention is PET/MRI imaging, as in NCT06172595/NCT06499831). cns5_terminology historical follows D30-R7; paediatric patients allowed, which D31-B1 leaves to S4.

revisions.reason: The record tests a non-drug imaging procedure ("a new imaging approach": simultaneous FET and FMISO PET/MRI, primary outcome "Detection of viable glioma based on PET"), with FET and FMISO only diagnostic_agent, so C1 does not allow no_pharmacological_candidate.
